text:
sasha: Heads up — after the kernel-selector patch we pushed this morning i'm seeing a noticeable p99/p95 increase on the reranker embeddings endpoint for non-chat flows. p99 ~35% higher on prod-rerank.
ria: Any flamegraphs or perf dumps yet?
sasha: quick summary from a 5m profiler: hot spots are kv_cache::serialize and kernel_selector::score. The batcher is producing a lot of tiny batches (1-2 requests) for rerank traffic — looks like token-budget gating is rejecting merges earlier than before.
sam: Can you paste the batcher config in use? token_budget_target changed in the last rollout iirc.
sasha: here's the relevant snippet from staging config:
```
batcher:
  preemptive_merge:
    window_ms: 20
    enabled: true
  early_fill:
    enabled: true
  token_budget_target: 0.9
  min_batch_tokens: 8
  max_batch_size: 16
  prefix_affinity: false
```
darren: That token_budget_target of 0.9 + tighter kernel selector means per-request fixed overhead increased (kernel setup for quantized kernels). The batcher only reasons about token counts today, so small batches now pay larger fixed cost => tail latency regresses.
ria: Suggest we augment cost model: estimate = fixed_cost + token_cost * n_tokens. Use kernel profiles to set fixed_cost per model+kernel and use that when deciding merges.
sam: We tried a local patch that added a preemptive-merge heuristic which considers an "est_fixed" term. In staging canary runs tail latency dropped ~18% and throughput was stable. However KV cache hit-rate dropped ~6% (we introduced reordering when merging unrelated keys), so overall latency wins but cache pressure increased.
sasha: KV thrash is a problem. We should gate merging on shard-level kv_pressure metric and prefer merging requests with shared prefix hash to preserve KV locality.
darren: Also need to prefetch KV keys if we merge requests that would have been separate — prefetch before kernel switch to avoid extra misses.
ci-bot: deploy:batcher-canary started for canary-45 on rerank-staging
sasha: quick profiling command i used: `./bin/perf-collect --thread rerank --since 5m` output excerpt:
```
Top samples:
  22% kv_cache::serialize
  18% kernel_selector::score
  12% batcher::form_batch
  8% rpc::send
```
ria: Proposed changes:
- add est_fixed_cost to kernel profiles (darren)
- change batcher cost model to fixed + per_token (sam)
- add kv_pressure gate + prefix_affinity preference (sasha)
- prefetch hooks on merged batches (darren)
- add telemetry: merged_batch_size, kv_pressure_at_merge, kv_hitrate_delta (ria)
sam: i'll test prefix_affinity=true + preemptive_merge.window_ms=12 + token_budget_target=1.2 in staging tonight.
sasha: SG. Also bump min_batch_size to 4 for non-chat rerank to avoid tiny RPC overhead, and keep max_batch_size at 16 for now.
ci-bot: ✅ tests passed for batcher-change branch
ria: action items assigned. i'll run A/B and post results here tomorrow morning.
sasha: thanks team — if anyone sees regression in other endpoints ping me. we'll iterate on thresholds once we have telemetry. :thumbsup:
